items.title: Hackers Leak Records of 41,000 DHS Personnel, Exposing Undercover ICE Agents
items.description: A leak of records covering more than 41,000 Department of Homeland Security employees and contractors has exposed contact details, work assignments, and links to sensitive operations, including undercover ICE work. items.title: WatchGuard Discloses 7 Critical Firewall Flaws Allowing Remote Code Execution and Root-Level Attacks
items.description: WatchGuard disclosed seven critical Fireware OS vulnerabilities in an October 27, 2026 advisory, affecting Firebox firewalls and potentially enabling remote code execution, root-level action injection, and memory corruption. items.title: Fortinet Brings AI Agent Security to Oracle Cloud to Block Prompt Injection and Data Leaks
items.description: Fortinet’s FortiAIGate is bringing AI security controls to enterprise workloads on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), helping businesses inspect prompts, block sensitive data leaks, and control agent actions. An Oracle announcement published October 27 outlines how customers can combine the self-hosted gateway with OCI Enterprise AI to protect applications connected to company data and tools.…

items.title: WordPress 7.1.4 Fixes 22 Security Flaws, Including an Unauthenticated RCE Vulnerability
items.description: WordPress released version 7.1.4 on October 28, 2026, fixing 22 security flaws, including an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in its update process. The security release also addresses stored cross-site scripting, data exposure, and access control issues. WordPress urges website owners to install the update immediately.
